_comment: GiantSpider's grown-up venom: a poison bite plus a poison dot, both on up to 2 nearest enemies within 1.6 units every 40 ticks. Bite: 3.5 HP plus 0.7 per level. Dot: 6 HP plus 1.2 per level over 5 ticks, 45-tick intervals. The bite exists so brief contact still deals damage. Both effects share radius, tickInterval and maxTargets since the aura sensor sizes to the largest. All values placeholder.
name: GiantVenomSpit
